title: ShapeQuery sometimes does not detect CSGShapes (with collision) on both Jolt and Godot physics
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducable in v4.5.1.stable.steam [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable (f62fdbde1) - Windows 11 (build 22000) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9144) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads) - 15.86 GiB memory

### Issue description

Using PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D sometimes does not register collision/intersection with CSG shapes (with collision enabled) via `direct_space_state.intersect_shape(params)`

### Steps to reproduce

-Create CSG Box with use_collision set to true
-Write a code to create query and do it every frame, query shape must be BoxShape3D
-Make sure query position is always random but it should be intersecting CSG Box, to make that, make size of query shape 1x1x1 meters, csg box size 1x1x1 meters, and random position of query in range or 0.5 to 0.5 on all axes
-Do intersect_shape(params) each frame/keypress or interval, and do something to visualize result (i do change shape color)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[minimap_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24351536/minimap_project.zip)

It is easy to reproduce but there is MRP just in case
